WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_keys, sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales) AS control_net, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS control_gross_of_returns, sum(r.returns_net) AS control_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, o.status, count(*) AS n_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND (s.store_id<>900 OR p.category='ZZ Test' OR o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected'))
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4
